claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing cybersecurity benchmarks often lack scale or end-to-end scope, limiting assessment of AI agents' practical utility in vulnerability remediation. CyberGym-E2E aims to address this by providing a large-scale, realistic environment for evaluating agents across the full vulnerability lifecycle.
